title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
authors: H. Touvron, T. Lavril, G. Izacard, et al. (14 authors)
before: Open models were either small or, like OPT and BLOOM, expensive to run and behind the frontier.
problem: Nobody had released a model that was both genuinely good and small enough to be useful on modest hardware.
breakthrough: Train smaller models far past compute-optimal on public data alone. LLaMA-13B outperformed GPT-3 175B.
why: The single most consequential open release. Everything in the 2023 open ecosystem is downstream of these weights.
next: Alpaca, llama.cpp, QLoRA and Llama 2 within months.
inherits: The small-but-overtrained recipe every open model now follows.
